# Trump's International Travels Mapped
U.S. President Donald Trump is headed to the United Kingdom for his second official state visit on Tuesday. Trump and the first lady are scheduled to meet with King Charles and Queen Camilla as well as UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer and other government officials.

...

Trump has visited the UK five times, more than any other country, [including in July](https://www.statista.com/topics/13639/the-second-trump-administration/) when he also met with Keir Starmer as well as European Union President Ursula von der Leyen.

...

He has visited several countries in Asia (compared to just one in Latin America) and paid many visits to European nations, including four visits to France and two each to Italy, Switzerland and Belgium. Germany, on the other hand, also a long-time U.S.
ally, has only seen one Trump visit, for the G20 summit in Hamburg in 2017. A bilateral visit with the German chancellor is still not on the agenda, which is highly unusual given the close cooperation of the two countries in the past.
Trump has also stopped by at Ramstein airbase in South-West Germany in 2018, but this visit is not counted as a visit to German territory [by the State Department.](https://history.state.gov/departmenthistory/travels/president/trump-donald-j/)
Another country that Trump has frequented is Japan (two bilateral visits and one summit visit). The most unusual country that Trump has visited is certainly North Korea, which the president walked into for about a minute when meeting North Korean leader Kim Jong-un in the Korean Demilitarized Zone.

...

# 10 places Donald Trump has travelled to as US President: from Afghanistan to North Korea
## Canada
Despite Canada being the US's closest neighbour, Trump has only made one visit to the country in his four years as president, in June 2018.
Read More
[US 2020 election: Inside 7 hotels where US residents can vote](https://www.thenationalnews.com/lifestyle/travel/us-2020-election-inside-7-hotels-where-us-residents-can-vote-1.1103385)

...

## France
Trump's favourite destination over the past few years has been France. He has made four trips to the country, visiting Paris, Normandy and Biarritz. On one trip to Paris, he had dinner with his wife Melania at the Michelin-starred restaurant in the Eiffel Tower.

...

## India
The last country Trump visited was India, where he flew in for a two-day visit in February 2020 before the global pandemic halted international travel. The 'Namaste Trump' tour saw him address crowds of more than 100,000 people, and he also found time to visit the Taj Mahal in Agra.

...

## North Korea
In June 2019, Trump made history with a visit to North Korea when he became the first sitting American commander-in-chief to set foot in the country. There, he met the leader Kim Jong-un at the heavily fortified Demilitarised Zone.

## Philippines
Trump flew to the Philippines in 2017, where he met President Rodrigo Duterte. The pair had built up something of a friendship in the run-up to their meeting, which came at the end of a November trip across Asia.

On May 19, 2017, President Donald Trump departed Washington, D.C., for his first international trip as president. The trip lasted eight days and took Trump to five different countries.

results.title: Inside President Trump’s Trip to Asia – The White House
excerpts:
# Inside President Trump’s Trip to Asia
On Friday, November 3, President Donald J. Trump departed for Asia, his longest foreign trip to date and the longest trip to Asia by an American president in more than a quarter-century.
The President used this trip to demonstrate the Administration’s commitment to the Indo-Pacific region and to strengthen U.S. alliances and partnerships. President Trump addressed a wide array of strategic issues with foreign leaders, including the North Korean nuclear threat.

...

President Trump stressed the United States’ commitment to the complete, verifiable, and permanent denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula and called on all responsible nations to act now to ensure that the North Korean regime cannot threaten the world with nuclear devastation.

...

During the State Visit, President Trump stressed the unsustainability of China’s unfair trade practices that have produced a massive trade deficit, and the President reaffirmed his determination to defend America’s economic interests.
The President continued on to Vietnam, where he delivered his second major address of the trip at the APEC CEO Summit in Da Nang, outlining the United States’ vision of a free and open Indo-Pacific region where free, fair, and reciprocal trade, as well as private sector-led investment and growth

...

President Trump concluded his trip in the Philippines, where he will held bilateral meetings with President Rodrigo Duterte, Prime Minister Narendra Modi of India, and Prime Minister Malcolm Turnbull of Australia, and attended the U.S.-ASEAN Summit and East Asia Summit.
